title: Encounter
description: A combat encounter: the participant list and inputs needed to check it against SF2E's XP-budget encounter math (see reference/tables/encounter-and-rewards-math.json) — distinct from challenge.schema.json (skill checks) and subsystem.schema.json (victory-point scenes), which don't use XP budgeting. A future validator can sum creatures[].level via the relative-level XP table and compare to encounterDifficultyThresholds for partySize.

partyLevel.description: For this campaign, almost always 12 (the Frames' fixed tier) — see design bible: Claimants are leveled to the Frame's tier, never the kids'.

partySize.description: How many Frames are actually deployed for this Contact, not the full roster of six.

intendedThreatLevel.description: The GM's design intent, to check against the computed budget.

creatureRef.description: id of a creature.schema.json file, if built.

level.description: Combat level, for XP-budget purposes even if creatureRef isn't set yet.

specialRules.description: Bespoke scripted overrides to normal encounter math, e.g. Episode One's Claimant being immune to damage until its interdiction field is broken by a ground-level call-out.

roundLimit.description: For a scripted fight with a fixed round count (e.g. Episode One's three-round structure).

groundRoleTieIns.description: id refs of challenge.schema.json instances running in parallel with this encounter (e.g. the five non-piloting kids' ground-role checks during a Contact).
